claims.text: Human crowd solutions exhibit higher average novelty compared to human-AI solutions.
Human crowd solutions exhibit higher novelty for highly novel outcomes compared to human-AI solutions.
Human-AI solutions demonstrate superior strategic viability compared to human crowd solutions.
Human-AI solutions demonstrate superior financial and environmental value compared to human crowd solutions.
Human-AI solutions demonstrate superior overall quality compared to human crowd solutions.
Human-AI solutions cocreated through differentiated search outperform solutions generated through independent search.

evidence.description: Evaluations by 300 external human evaluators showed human crowd solutions exhibited higher average novelty.
Evaluations across 3,900 evaluator-solution pairs showed human crowd solutions achieved higher novelty for highly novel outcomes.
Human-AI solutions scored higher on strategic viability across evaluator-solution pairings.
Human-AI solutions scored higher on financial and environmental value in external evaluations.
Human-AI solutions demonstrated superior overall quality ratings across 3,900 evaluation pairs.
Differentiated search, instructing LLMs sequentially to generate outputs distinct from prior iterations, yielded better solutions than independent search.

methodologies.name: Crowdsourcing evaluation with human-AI prompt engineering and randomized evaluator pairing
methodologies.description: A crowdsourcing challenge engaging 125 global solvers to generate circular economy business ideas using human crowd generation, independent human-AI search, and differentiated human-AI search, evaluated by 300 external human evaluators across 3,900 pairings.

future_work.text: Investigating how integrating human-AI solution search processes can drive more impactful innovations.
